d:
Pangat 2.0 was a beautiful celebration of the rich and diverse sweets of Bihar. The event brought together food lovers, chefs and cultural enthusiasts under one roof. It was not just about food, but also about stories, traditions and heritage.
Anubhav was invited to be a part of the conclave. The panel discussion was insightful and engaging. It explored the legacy of Bihari cuisine and the importance of preserving regional food traditions.
